usage: corvint-companion-release --source-root DIR --scratch DIR --output-parent DIR --bundle-name NAME [--target GOOS/GOARCH] [--tasks-only] [--npm-cache DIR]
--bundle-name: name of the retained bundle directory under -output-parent (required)
--npm-cache: retained compatibility argument; unused by core bundle
--output-parent: directory the retained bundle is placed under (required; must be outside -source-root)
--scratch: scratch working directory (required)
--source-root: clean Corvint source checkout (required)
--target: GOOS/GOARCH pair to build (darwin/arm64; with -tasks-only also cross-built linux/amd64)
--tasks-only: build only the standalone Tasks archive; no full bundle qualification
usage: corvint-companion-release --source-root DIR --scratch DIR --output-parent DIR --bundle-name NAME [--target GOOS/GOARCH] [--tasks-only] [--npm-cache DIR]
